transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug, priority:medium, area:compliance and lore:blocked, and was opened 2026-10-23. The message TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA, shipped in #151/#439, ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" (a colleague will follow up). No escalation destination is configured while KU-14 is open, so nobody is notified to make that follow-up. The issue is blocked on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). PR #495 had flagged the same problem.
